To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
multiview learning improves entity typing accuracy and that the multiview entity typing dataset we release is a valuable resource for evaluating mono- and multilingual entity typing systems.
multiview learning is an effective approach to entity typing, especially when multilingual and multi-representation views are combined.

(i) multiview learning is effective for fine-grained entity type classification; (ii) it is effective for multilingual entity typing; and (iii) it is particularly effective for multilingual fine-grined entity typing, i.e., multiview learning can help close the gap between high- and low-resource languages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How can we improve the coverage of fine-grained entity type information in multilingual knowledge bases?
the following questions: (i) How to increase accuracy and coverage of KBs?
the creation of multiview datasets and multiview learning systems for NLP.

multiview learning is effective for entity typing.
multiview learning, and multiview learning with multilingual data is effective for fine-grained entity type classification.
multiview learning is an effective approach for increasing accuracy and/or coverage of entity typing systems.

multilingual multiview learning is a promising direction for entity typing.
